<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="cacbc7742bb676104572f3745e91bf5a" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>false</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_birl3_clm_bank_guarantee_monitor</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition table="x_birl3_clm_bank_guarantee_monitor">credit_limitISNOTEMPTY^EQ<item endquery="false" field="credit_limit" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="ISNOTEMPTY" or="false" value=""/><item endquery="true" field="" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="=" or="false" value=""/></filter_condition><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>CLM: NT BG CL Update</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/) {

  var rawSegment = (current.getValue('credit_segment') || '').trim();
  var creditSegment = (rawSegment === 'RMC' || rawSegment === 'URMX') ? 'URMX' : 'GIL';

  var customerSite = current.customer_site_code;
  var customerCodeVal = '';
  if (customerSite) {
    customerCodeVal = customerSite.customer_code_sap || customerSite.customer_code || current.getValue('customer_site_code');
  }

  var rawLimit = current.getValue('credit_limit') || 0;
  if (typeof rawLimit === 'string' && rawLimit.indexOf(';') > -1) {
    rawLimit = rawLimit.split(';')[1];
  }
  var cleanLimit = parseFloat(rawLimit) || 0;

  var q = new GlideRecord('x_birl3_clm_clm_servicenow_to_sap_send_back');
  q.initialize();
  q.setValue('bg_request', current.getUniqueValue());
  q.setValue('u_customer_code', customerCodeVal);
  q.setValue('u_approved_code_limit', cleanLimit);
  q.setValue('u_old_credit_limit', parseFloat(current.getValue('old_credit_limit')) || 0);
  q.setValue('u_next_review_date', current.getValue('next_review_date'));
  q.setValue('u_credit_segment', creditSegment);
  q.setValue('customer_type', 'non_trade_bg');
  q.setValue('u_customer_type', 'non_trade_bg');
  q.setValue('u_status', 'Pending');
  q.setValue('u_attempt_count', 0);
  q.setValue('u_connection_retry_count', 0);
  q.insert();

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>gaurav.gorane@mindsprint.com</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-04 14:28:52</sys_created_on><sys_domain>cacbc7742bb676104572f3745e91bf5a</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>353504ae979cdb10be31fa17f053af57</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>CLM: NT BG CL Update</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="CLM" source="x_birl3_clm">d01e8ce22bb27e104572f3745e91bfe3</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="CLM">d01e8ce22bb27e104572f3745e91bfe3</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_353504ae979cdb10be31fa17f053af57</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>gaurav.gorane@mindsprint.com</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-04 14:28:52</sys_updated_on><template/><when>after</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=353504ae979cdb10be31fa17f053af57"/></record_update>
